description: This file defines the EmployeeJoinedDateChangedEvent class which extends the Event class. It models an event triggered when an employee's join date changes, encapsulating the employee object and the previous join date.

classes.name: EmployeeJoinedDateChangedEvent
classes.description: A PHP class representing an event that occurs when an employee's joining date is changed.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for EmployeeJoinedDateChangedEvent, initializing with an Employee object and optional previous join date.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this event.

methods.name: getPreviousJoinedDate
methods.description: Returns the previous join date if available.
